description: DynamoDB stores items addressed by keys. A partition key groups related items, and a sort key orders them within that group. Learn the request shapes with a local practice table and a small book list. Use DynamoDB Local and the AWS CLI or SDK in a separate practice project. Point every command at http://localhost:8000. Low-level JSON examples show request bodies; provide them to the matching CLI command or SDK method.
versionNote: Uses DynamoDB core table/item/query APIs with DynamoDB Local; no real AWS resources are created by this site.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to check that the table key names match the item design
Learn to explain why this query does not read every reader partition
Learn to try the condition with a genuinely new book key
